minutes.headline: Committee heard FY16 school budget requests and a technology plan, adopted two-year goals, and went into executive session.
minutes.summary: The meeting covered the superintendent's report, a building project update, a calendar advisory report for next year, and a one-to-one device plan with FY16 budget requests from technology, primary, middle and high school. The committee voted to approve prior minutes and accept two-year goals, then went to executive session on non-union bargaining strategy. The superintendent's full recommended budget comes on the 17th, with a hearing after the governor's budget in March.

what_happened.line: The School Committee heard a one-to-one device plan with three options, and none was chosen at this meeting.
The committee heard FY16 budget requests from technology, primary, middle and high school; each was presented, and none was voted.
The committee voted to accept its two-year goals; the motion passed.
The budget hearing was set for after the governor's budget in March, not January.
The building project's technology allowance was said to cover infrastructure but not full one-to-one, and asbestos abatement at Turkey Hill falls to the town.

why_it_matters: Whether students get district-owned devices or must bring their own affects family costs and IT staffing, and the options heard would be paid from building project funds, the district budget or parents.
The Turkey Hill abatement cost is not paid by the state building authority, so it would fall on the town budget, mostly taxes, before upgrades can proceed.
watch_next: Superintendent's full recommended budget, with the athletic budget, presented December 17 at TC Passios room 13.
A date for a one-to-one technology workshop in January or February, to be set at the next meeting.
